level_purpose: sections define repeatable internal obligations for every chapter before any prose is written
level_specific_rationale: L3 gives every chapter the same minimum section duties: reader task, core material, evidence/corpus anchor, and transition boundary.
This prevents later drafting from producing chapters that explain content but forget why the reader needs it, what evidence supports it, or how it connects forward.

next_level_contract.must_add: L4 must state inclusion rules under each section without collapsing inherited sections
must_not_change: collapse two inherited nodes into one
insert manuscript prose, release payloads, or publication metadata
assess fill maturity before the fill-control phase
must_preserve: all inherited_locked_nodes exactly as inherited from parent
all parent hashes and combined node order
L1 approved frozen titles and ordering
